title: BRISA Patong by Sansiri
shortDescription: BRISA Patong is a Sansiri condominium of 389 homes in three eight-storey buildings on about 4 rai in central Patong.
description: BRISA Patong is a Sansiri condominium of 389 homes in three eight-storey buildings on about 4 rai in central Patong. Homes are one- and two-bedroom units of roughly 30 to 71 sqm, with about 70 percent being one-bedroom units. Units are handed over furnished. Planned facilities include a pool, gym, sauna, cold plunge and a garden.
